root_cause.primary: live PowerShell called nonexistent Directory.Set/GetUnixFileMode APIs on Unix
root_cause.cascade: the release job invoked image-dependent critical and recovery tests without first building the exact local images and without fetching historical tags
root_cause.false_green_source: prior local critical evidence inherited prebuilt images, complete Git tags, Docker Desktop Scout authentication, and a persistent scanner cache from the operator workstation
root_cause.service_identity: ancestor/tag rediscovery is not a stable GitHub service-container contract; the official job.services.postgres.id context is
root_cause.scanner: Docker Scout v1.23.1 for Linux requires Docker ID even for a hermetic exact local image with DOCKER_SCOUT_OFFLINE=true; the release job intentionally has no package credentials
